# Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness

## Overview

Build a single-page e-commerce landing site for **Fresh Pantry**, a neighborhood grocery brand that celebrates unique, high-quality food products at great prices. The audience is health-conscious grocery shoppers who love discovering new finds — think the excitement of wandering a well-curated store aisle, translated to the web. The tone should feel **warm, playful, and modern** — approachable but polished, never corporate or sterile.

## Visual & Style Direction

- **Color palette:** Think fresh greens, warm cream/off-white backgrounds, pops of sunny yellow or terracotta for accents. Avoid harsh neons or overly dark tones.
- **Typography:** A friendly rounded sans-serif for headings (something like Nunito or Poppins) paired with a clean body font. Keep it legible and inviting.
- **Imagery mood:** Bright, natural-light food photography vibes. Use placeholder images that suggest colorful produce, pantry staples, and cozy store interiors.
- **Layout:** Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, subtle shadows — the whole page should feel like a pleasant stroll through a sunlit market.

## Key Priorities

1. **The featured products carousel** is the centerpiece interaction — make sure the left/right navigation feels smooth and the product cards (with images, names, and prices) are visually appealing and easy to scan.
2. **The store locator** should feel functional and responsive: a zip code input with a search button that reveals mock store results. This drives the core business goal of in-store visits.
3. **Brand highlights stats** (500+ stores, 4,000+ products, etc.) should be presented as an eye-catching banner — use bold numbers with supporting labels to build credibility at a glance.
4. **Category hover effects** should feel delightful but not distracting — a gentle scale-up with an overlay is the target.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section list, all interaction specs, data display requirements, and navigation structure.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

I’m going to inspect the provided brief + JSON specs, then build the full static landing page (HTML/CSS/JS) in `/app/output` with the required carousel, store locator interaction, stats banner, and category hover effects.

# Fresh Pantry — Discover Everyday Deliciousness

## Brand

Fresh Pantry is your neighborhood grocery store reimagined — a place where quality meets affordability and every aisle holds a delicious surprise. We curate unique, hard-to-find food products alongside everyday essentials, all at prices that make you smile. Our mission is simple: make great food accessible to everyone, with a warm, welcoming shopping experience that feels like home.

Brand colors: #2D6A4F (primary forest green), #F4A261 (warm accent orange), #FEFAE0 (soft cream background)

## Hero Content

Title: "Discover Everyday Deliciousness"
Subtitle: "Unique flavors, quality ingredients, and unbeatable prices — all waiting for you at your neighborhood Fresh Pantry."
CTA: "Find a Store Near You" | "Explore This Week's Picks"

## Header Navigation

- Products
- Our Stores
- Recipes
- About Us

## Featured Products

A horizontally scrollable carousel of staff-favorite grocery items. Each card displays the product name, a short descriptor, and price.

| Product Name | Description | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Organic Maple Granola | Crunchy clusters with real maple syrup and toasted oats | $3.99 |
| Everything But The Bagel Seasoning | A savory blend of sesame, garlic, onion & poppy seeds | $2.49 |
| Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups | Rich dark chocolate with creamy peanut butter filling | $3.49 |
| Cauliflower Gnocchi | Light, pillowy gnocchi made with real cauliflower | $2.99 |
| Mandarin Orange Chicken | Crispy chicken bites in a sweet & tangy mandarin sauce | $4.99 |
| Unexpected Cheddar Cheese | Aged cheddar with crystalline crunch and complex flavor | $3.99 |
| Spicy Mango Lemonade | Tropical mango with a kick of chili and fresh lemon | $2.79 |
| Truffle Marcona Almonds | Roasted marcona almonds dusted with black truffle salt | $4.49 |

Interaction: Left/right arrow buttons slide the product cards horizontally to reveal additional items.

## Seasonal Picks

Title: "Summer Favorites Are Here 🌞"
Subtitle: "Limited-time flavors crafted for the season — grab them before they're gone!"

- **Watermelon Mint Sparkling Water** — Refreshing fizz with real watermelon essence and a hint of mint. $1.99
- **Grilled Peach & Burrata Salad Kit** — Everything you need for a summer salad in one box. $5.49
- **Coconut Cold Brew Concentrate** — Smooth, creamy cold brew with natural coconut flavor. $6.99
- **Mango Sticky Rice Spring Rolls** — A sweet twist on a classic, ready in minutes. $3.99

## Product Categories

A grid of category cards. On hover, each card scales up slightly and displays an overlay with the category name.

- **Snacks & Sweets** — Chips, cookies, trail mixes, and guilty pleasures
- **Fresh Produce** — Seasonal fruits, vegetables, and organic picks
- **Frozen Favorites** — Meals, appetizers, and desserts straight from the freezer
- **Beverages** — Juices, sparkling waters, coffees, and teas
- **Dairy & Cheese** — Artisan cheeses, yogurts, milk, and plant-based alternatives

## Brand Highlights

Key statistics displayed in a bold highlights banner across the page.

- **500+ Stores Nationwide** — From coast to coast, there's a Fresh Pantry near you
- **4,000+ Unique Products** — Curated items you won't find anywhere else
- **80% Private Label Items** — Our own brand means better quality at lower prices
- **New Items Every Week** — There's always something new to discover

## Store Locator

Title: "Find Your Fresh Pantry"
Subtitle: "Enter your zip code to discover the nearest store, hours, and directions."

Input placeholder: "Enter your zip code"
Button: "Search"

Sample results after search:

| Store Name | Address | Hours | Distance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fresh Pantry — Lincoln Park | 2140 N. Halsted St, Chicago, IL 60614 | 8am – 9pm Daily | 0.8 mi |
| Fresh Pantry — Wicker Park | 1840 W. North Ave, Chicago, IL 60622 | 8am – 9pm Daily | 1.4 mi |
| Fresh Pantry — Lakeview | 3745 N. Lincoln Ave, Chicago, IL 60613 | 8am – 9pm Daily | 2.1 mi |

## Newsletter

Title: "Stay Fresh 🍋"
Subtitle: "Sign up for weekly deals, new product alerts, and seasonal recipes delivered to your inbox."

Input placeholder: "Your email address"
Button: "Subscribe"
Confirmation message: "Thanks for subscribing! Check your inbox for a welcome treat."

## Footer Navigation

Shop: Products · Seasonal Picks · New Arrivals · Gift Cards
Company: About Us · Careers · Press · Sustainability
Help: Store Locator · FAQs · Contact Us · Accessibility
Follow Us: Instagram · Facebook · Pinterest · TikTok

Tagline in footer: "© 2024 Fresh Pantry. Discover Everyday Deliciousness."---
